source.title: 運動風穿搭成新潮流？看看男星們都怎樣穿衛衣風褸等單品 隨性同時展現活力 (Is Athleisure the New Trend? How Male Stars Wear Hoodies and Windbreakers)
source.author: Vogue Hong Kong

tips.text: Use athleisure for relaxed weekend dressing.
tips.why: It is practical and comfortable across many casual situations.

tips.text: An easy athleisure formula: a windbreaker with joggers, or a sweatshirt with a cap.
tips.why: Both pairings are simple and hard to get wrong.

tips.text: Make sporty pieces look considered through colour coordination and layering.
tips.why: Planned colours and layers lift basic sportswear above gym clothes.

tips.text: Wear a tracksuit in one deep colour from top to bottom, with flat shoes.
tips.why: A single dark shade looks unified; flat shoes keep it casual.

tips.text: If an all-black, white and grey athleisure outfit feels flat, add one contrasting coloured jacket, such as a mint windbreaker.
tips.why: One fresh colour gives neutral sportswear a focal point.

tips.text: Layer a scarf over a sporty jacket.
tips.why: It adds depth to a streetwear look.

tips.text: An oversized warm-toned sweatshirt over a white tee with loose jeans is an easy, low-effort casual outfit.
tips.why: It looks put together with almost no styling.

outfits.outfit: track-jacket charcoal sporty +tracksuit, track-pants charcoal sporty +tracksuit
outfits.why: A tracksuit in one deep grey looks unified and relaxed.
